h: The Speech of Shabbos Repairs the Past and Guards Tomorrow

p: In the haftarah for this parsha:
שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר ה׳ בֵּית יַעֲקֹב וְגוֹ׳ (יִרְמְיָה ב, ד)
"Hear the word of Hashem, House of Yaakov," etc. (Yirmiyahu 2:4).
In the Pesikta on this haftarah (Pesikta Rabbasi 27:1):
"You have nullified all the commandments," etc.;
"even one thing, had you kept it,
This is the day of Shabbos," etc.;
לְכָךְ נֶאֱמַר שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר ה׳ וְגוֹ׳
"therefore it says, 'Hear the word of Hashem,' etc.;
'from pursuing your affairs and speaking a word';
'And you, speak to the Children of Israel.'"
that "davar" means only Shabbos, from pesukim
is according to the hidden teaching,
כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א לב, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (I 32a):
"And this speech is called Shabbos," etc.,
Shabbos corresponds to the seventh attribute,
we call it Torah she'b'al peh.
And for this it brought the proof
"from pursuing your affairs and speaking a word."
And this is as we infer
that your speech on Shabbos should not be
just as it is written "mi'metzo cheftzecha."
Rather, the meaning of "ve'daber davar" is
that on Shabbos a person must
דְּבָרַי אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתִּי בְּפִיךָ (יְשַׁעְיָה נט, כא)
"My words that I have placed in your mouth" (Yeshayahu 59:21).
And as it says in Sefer Yetzirah:
"The day of Shabbos in the year,
and the mouth in the soul";
that on Shabbos the mouth was created to speak,
and gave names to all the creatures.
that on Shabbos the mouth in the soul was created,
so that a person can speak
and be in the aspect of the Mouth of Hashem:
"My words that I have placed in your mouth."
'Then those who feared Hashem spoke,'" etc.
וְלֵימָא מִדְּבָרָיו שֶׁל רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל וְכוּלֵּי
"Let it say, 'from the words of Rabban Gamliel,'" etc.,
"that even the casual talk of talmidei chachamim," etc.
And as is written in Rashi's commentary:
That is, Shabbos is called speech
and this is why it brings the proof
And as for its bringing proof
"And you, speak to the Children of Israel"
this is according to what is written
in the holy Zohar (beginning of Parshas Tetzaveh),
as including the Shechinah with Him:
the sun rests in the moon
the Written Torah and Torah she'b'al peh,
as they said (in the Yerushalmi, perek Chelek).
speak to the Children of Israel,"
which is the attribute of Malchus, the Mouth.
And the main proof appears to be
and here it is already written,
"Speak to the Children of Israel, lemor"?
that he should instill this power in Yisrael,
that is, amirah, speech in a whisper;
"My saying shall distill like the dew,"
how it comes down from heaven,
when Yisrael then have the power
that will be the Mouth of Hashem,
"For in much wisdom is much anger";
they would have been given only
the five books of the Torah," etc.
And this is the meaning of
that you nullified all the commandments.
they can rectify everything in the past,
"Even if he worshipped idols like the generation of Enosh,
"'Who keeps the Shabbos from desecrating it,
and keeps his hand from doing any evil'":
for he is guarded from everything.
